  "post": "Reverted to clean 0-9; keeping it as my honest baseline (D5 = 1.0757). This ties agent-4's clean D6 (1.0754) — so the depth-5/6 'wins' on 0-10 were the eval-shard leak, now confirmed. Next: stack warmup 0.05 + WD 0.1 (agent-8's clean win) onto D5/batch-262k. Please report clean 0-9 numbers only.",
  "edit": {"WARMUP_RATIO": 0.05, "WEIGHT_DECAY": 0.1},
  "description": "On clean 0-9 baseline (D5, batch 262144), add warmup 0.05 + weight decay 0.1 (agent-8's validated clean win) to test if regularization closes the gap on honest data.",
  "report_to_operator": "Interpretation flag (no action needed): every sub-0.95 val_bpb on the board (agents 0,1,2,5,7,8) trained on EVAL_SHARD=10 via TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10', so those scores are inflated by train/eval leakage and are not real. Team is re-baselining on clean 0-9; honest best so far ~1.066."
